---
# Filename stays `schedule.qmd` so the published /schedule.html URL keeps
# working; only the title and navbar label changed when weeks became chapters.
# This page is now a table of contents -- the chapter-to-date mapping lives in
# whatever LMS is pointing at this site, which owns anything with a date on it.
title: "Contents"
toc: false
# Full width so the three cards in a unit each get room for a one-line title.
# In the default article column they are 257px wide whatever the screen size.
page-layout: full
---

```{=html}
<style>
/* Unit heading: the letter carries the unit, so it gets the weight and the
   name sits next to it as plain text rather than competing for it. */
.unit-letter {
  display: inline-block;
  background-color: #2780e3;
  color: #fff;
  border-radius: 0.35rem;
  padding: 0.02em 0.45em;
  margin-right: 0.15em;
  font-weight: 700;
}

h2:has(.unit-letter) {
  border-bottom: none;
  margin-top: 2.75rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.unit-desc {
  color: #6c757d;
  margin: 0 0 1.1rem;
  max-width: 46rem;
}

/* Chapter cards. auto-fit rather than auto-fill so a unit's three chapters
   spread across the row instead of leaving a phantom fourth column. */
.chapter-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(15rem, 1fr));
  gap: 0.85rem;
  /* Full-page layout has no column of its own, so cap the run here rather than
     letting three cards stretch across a very wide monitor. */
  max-width: 76rem;
}

/* The whole card is the link, so the click target is the card and not just
   the title. Nothing else inside it may be an anchor. */
a.chapter-card {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
  border: 1px solid #e9ecef;
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
  background-color: #fff;
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}

a.chapter-card:hover,
a.chapter-card:focus-visible {
  border-color: #2780e3;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(39, 128, 227, 0.12);
}

.chapter-num {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.1;
  color: #c9dcf5;
}

a.chapter-card:hover .chapter-num {
  color: #2780e3;
}

.chapter-title {
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.25;
  margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
}

a.chapter-card:hover .chapter-title {
  color: #2780e3;
}

/* Hanging indent so a wrapped lecture title lines up under its own text
   rather than sliding back under the a/b/c letter. */
.lec {
  display: block;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  color: #6c757d;
  line-height: 1.45;
  padding-left: 1.05em;
  text-indent: -1.05em;
}

.lec b {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 1.05em;
  text-indent: 0;
  color: #adb5bd;
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* Chapters that are outline-only: same card, less ink, so the unit still
   reads as a whole rather than having holes in it. */
a.chapter-card.pending {
  background-color: #fbfcfd;
  border-style: dashed;
}

/* Unit-closing translation activity. Set apart from the grid because it
   belongs to the unit rather than to any one chapter. */
.unit-extra {
  margin-top: 0.7rem;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}

/* The marker goes on the paragraph, not the wrapping div: a ::before on the
   div lands in block context and takes a line of its own. */
.unit-extra p {
  margin: 0;
}

.unit-extra p::before {
  content: "\21B3";
  color: #adb5bd;
  margin-right: 0.45em;
}
</style>
```

Fifteen chapters across five units. Each chapter runs two or three lectures of
about 75 to 90 minutes, and each lecture carries its own practice and assignment.
